text:
emma: Hey team — proposing a short 3-part webinar mini-series called 'Spark Labs' focused on practical inference ops for engineers. Target audience: platform + infra engineers. Goal: show latency/cost tradeoffs, routing & fallback patterns, and a live 'scaling lab' demo. Prefer 3 Wednesdays in May. Thoughts?

raj: Love it. For demos we should prep 2 traffic profiles: bursty API and steady embedding jobs. Can we define a concise run-of-session for each? I can cover routing/fallbacks. Speakers: raj (routing), sophia (benchmarks), taylor (customer framing).

sophia: +1. Want concrete numbers — per-token cost vs q8 quant model, SLA impact of batching, and a simple graph comparing Dedicated vs hosted. I'll prep a 6-slide benchmark narrative and 3 eval prompts. ETA Thu.

oliver: Ops checklist: reserve a Dedicated pool for a 2-hour rehearsal before each session, enable traffic replay (anonymized), and ensure recording enabled. Need a runbook for fallback model and token billing notes. I'll add infra calendar holds.

taylor: I can do persona framing and 2 short case studies. For inbound routing, propose tagging leads by session + intent. Proposed tags: `spark-labs.session=1|2|3` and `lead_stage=trial|evaluation|purchase`. OK?

emma: Routing snippet example to share with sales/dev:
```
routing:
  session_tag: spark-labs.session
  fallback_model: redwood-medium-q8
  lead_tags: [spark-labs.session, lead_stage]
  tracker_props: {utm, source, demo_requested}
```
Also rehearsal cadence: week-before dry run (full), day-of tech check 30m, host script with explicit fallback lines. Everyone confirm speaker commitments by EOD Fri.

sophia: Confirmed. I'll push benchmark deck to the marketing drive and attach the 3 eval prompt sets for QA.

raj: I'll do the live routing demo but need a short prep doc (commands to run + where to watch logs). Can @oliver pair with me on the runbook?

oliver: Yup, I'll pair. I'll add a small section in the runbook labelled "failover cue" with the exact phrase to use during demo: 'Switching to fallback model to preserve latency — demo continues.' :white_check_mark:

zara-bot: calendar: 3 events created by emma for Spark Labs sessions — placeholders with 'TBD link'. Reminders set for hosts 48h/1h before.

emma: Great. I'll create the landing page + segmented nurture flow this week. Action items: emma = landing & promo by Tue, sophia = bench slides Thu, raj+oliver = runbook Mon before rehearsal, taylor = case studies Fri. I'll send calendar invites and a short host script now. :rocket:
